market_summary: Across the board during the London session, markets are exhibiting corrective or consolidative behavior following earlier directional extensions. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and BTCUSD remain structurally bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50 baselines inside their session Value Areas, but lack the high RVOL (>2.0 yellow spikes) required to confirm continuation breakdowns toward ATR lower bands. GBPUSD staged a sharp mean-reversion rally from session lows but is now stretched directly into the +2 ATR upper band and Session High resistance, making chasing ill-advised. US100 is drifting mid-channel above key S/R support inside its CME Globex Value Area ahead of the New York open. With GEX inactive and volume unsupportive of clean trend expansion, discipline dictates maintaining a HOLD across all symbols.

In terms of ATR bands, price is positioned in the lower-mid channel above the lower band (3885.45). With lack of volume breakout confirmation inside the Value Area, a disciplined HOLD is warranted.
